rule_of_coverage: every path the accepted specification or a committed fixture of this profile observes (vendor envelope; tool and user data subtrees are dispositioned as whole payloads) has exactly one disposition: normalized (a portable destination, the contract rule, and an oracle property that was VERIFIED with an occurrence on an evidence fixture in the same test run), retained (whole-record retention VERIFIED on the evidence fixture), omitted (a reviewed tested rule; none exists), or unresolved (retained, with the open question stated). FieldDispositionTest fails on a missing or duplicate disposition, a stale entry, an unresolvable destination, an undeclared rule, an unexercised normalized claim or a test reference that does not exist.
